summary.en: The Chunghwa Telecom 5G Accelerator, established in 2018, is Taiwan's first telecom 5G accelerator. Run by the incumbent telco as a corporate-VC-based platform, it provides 5G testbeds, PoC environments, business opportunities and funding matchmaking. By end of 2025 it had selected 82 startup teams across cohorts focused on 5G, AI and digital transformation.

summary.en: Far EasTone launched its Startup Accelerator at the end of 2021 as Taiwan's first 5G/metaverse-oriented telco accelerator. Using a 'big helps small' co-creation model, it pairs startups with FET group business units. Across its first two batches it accelerated 37 startups; by batch 3 the program had generated over NT$170M in digital-transformation business opportunities and attracted over NT$450M in investment/capital increases. Batch-2 themes spanned smart healthcare, ESG net-zero, smart retail, smart cities/manufacturing and finance/insurance.

summary.en: The Wistron Accelerator was launched in September 2021 by ICT manufacturer Wistron in a long-term strategic partnership with AppWorks. It runs a four-month, equity-free, PoC-driven program where startups co-develop MVPs directly with Wistron Group business units, receive C-level mentorship, a NT$200K subsidy, and potential follow-on investment from Wistron's CVC team. Focus areas include AI, IoT, cloud, cybersecurity, EduTech and MedTech.

summary.en: The Cathay Financial Innovation Lab is Cathay Financial Holdings' corporate open-innovation / accelerator program, launched in 2019. It globally screens fintech and AI startups (over 400 in its first phase, selecting 9) and runs proof-of-concept projects across its life-insurance, banking, securities and property-insurance subsidiaries. Its first phase completed ~70% PoC success — far above the 20-30% typical of enterprise accelerators — and Cathay does not rule out taking equity for deeper collaboration.

summary.en: TAI1 AI Accelerator, launched in May 2025, is billed as Taiwan's first AI accelerator. Run by enterprise accelerator StarFab together with NVIDIA Inception, it invests NT$3 million per selected startup via a SAFE (through ITIC Innovation Investment), and connects AI startups with Taiwan's leading manufacturing, healthcare, robotics, retail and logistics industries plus NVIDIA's technical and global resources. Its inaugural cohort of 13 startups (including Futurenest) showcased at NVIDIA GTC 2026.
